name: Email Entry to Password Entry
summary: The user enters an email address, chooses Password, and the client advances to password entry without revealing whether the account exists.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.email is visible

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Email address entered by the user. Advancing to password entry does not prove that a durable identity exists for the address.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.email.password is visible and account-existence remains undisclosed

sourceReferences.note: The email view is a shared credential-choice fork. Password Sign In owns action:continue-password and Passkey Sign In owns action:continue-passkey.
